# Lagged & Loaded {.unlisted .hero-title}

[A Time Series Analysis Portfolio]{.hero-subtitle}

[Isabella Lethbridge · LTHISA001 · 25 August 2026]{.hero-meta}
:::
:::

This portfolio records my work in Time Series Analysis, from stationarity and autocorrelation to state space and hidden Markov models. Alongside my section notes and a learning journal, it contains four projects on real data: Eskom electricity demand, Western Cape dam levels and Pacific sea surface temperatures, and JSE All Share Index returns.
